slots.title: The White House's crypto chief departs: State of Crypto
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Patrick Witt announced his departure from the White House last week.

slots.title: Wall Street freaked out Friday. VIX and bitcoin say the fear may fade Monday.
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Wall Street's fear gauge, the VIX index, spiked on Friday as stocks dropped. History says Friday panics usually fade on Monday. Seasonality and calm bitcoin suggest the same.

slots.title: Anthropic says it’s committing 5% of its shares to a ‘public benefit fund’
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: Anthropic said that it will commit 5% of its shares to the fund.

slots.title: Disney agrees to hire the majority of Character.AI’s workforce
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: The filing also says that the “vast majority” of Character.AI employees who were offered jobs at Disney accepted them. However, this is a stalking horse bid, so another company could come forward with a higher offer.

slots.title: Latvia eyes crypto tax payments in 2027 as parliament overhauls crypto taxation
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Parliament passed a law taxing crypto withdrawals above deposits rather than individual trades, featuring a one-time declaration mechanism.

slots.title: Stablecoin supply stalls, but payments jump 45% as Visa, Mastercard and Stripe connect crypto to cash
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Analytics firm Allium said stablecoin payments hit $482 billion this year so far, up 45%, as card spending surges and global payment firms add crypto rails.
